investigation_notes.Description: An anomalous Office 365 login was observed for riina.maasik@client.ee from Dubai, UAE, which is outside the user's typical login region. The login succeeded but MFA was enforced and the device is company-managed and compliant; the source IP has a clean reputation and is from a fixed-line UAE ISP. A recent similar alert for the same user (SOC-105) was closed as a false positive after the user was confirmed to be traveling. Given the presence of MFA, managed device status, clean IP reputation, and matching travel-consistent activity, this is assessed as low priority.
investigation_notes.IP Reputation Summary: Abuse Confidence Score 0/100; ISP: Emirates Telecommunications Corporation; Fixed-line ISP; not identified as VPN/Proxy/Tor
